name: Hotel Starter Pack
shortDescription: Body & hand wash, floor, surface and glass cleaners, softener, bleach and air freshener for hotels and guest houses.
description: Everything housekeeping needs to get guest rooms, bathrooms and linen ready: refill sizes of body & hand wash for guest bathrooms, cleaners for floors, surfaces and mirrors, fabric softener and bleach for linen, and air freshener for rooms and corridors.
ingredients: See each product's page for ingredients.
howToUse: Follow the directions on each product label.
safety: Keep all products out of reach of children and unauthorised persons. Never mix cleaning products. Store in a cool, dry place out of direct sunlight.

faqs.q: Can you deliver this every month?
faqs.a: Yes. Request a scheduled delivery on our Wholesale page or WhatsApp us, and we'll agree a regular delivery day.
